92ab2299e6bc6166.title: MAROONS
92ab2299e6bc6166.desc: MAROONS is a genre-bending theatrical performance that reimagines the history of marronage (resisting or liberating oneself from slavery) as a living, time-bending practice of escape and collective freedom. Set in 1833 and beyond, the work opens with a real runaway slave advertisement and blossoms into a layered journey following Eve and Celine, two women who refuse the conditions imposed on them and make a daring escape toward a hidden colony of maroons. Along the way, they encounter shifting timelines, ancestral voices, and a network of maroons who exist across the past, present, and future. Their journey is guided by coded messages and ritual, revealing freedom as something built in movement and refusal. The performance blends theater, music, choreography, and visual spectacle to create an immersive world where history fractures and reassembles with maroons like Harriet Tubman. MAROONS transforms the stage into a portal and invites the audience into a space filled with new possibilities emerging from the refusal of oppressive systems. This performance is supported in part by the Los Angeles County Department of Arts and Culture.

92011f85366e3f5d.title: Divorce Care Higher Vision Church
92011f85366e3f5d.desc: No matter how amiable, separation or divorce is one of the most painful experiences. But you are not alone: there is a DivorceCare support group for people walking through separation or divorce. DivorceCare is a safe, welcoming place where people understand the difficult emotions and challenges of separation and divorce. Over 13 weeks, you’ll find relief and comfort as you learn what to expect in the days ahead and how to navigate your personal healing journey. Since separation and divorce can be messy and confusing, you’ll learn helpful ways of coping with the challenges and navigating relationships—and gain solid support each step of the way. Topics include how to manage divorce-related emotions such as loneliness, anxiety, bitterness, anger, and grief; how to cope with the changes in your life and relationships; the importance of forgiveness; and how to navigate legal and financial issues. At a weekly DivorceCare meeting, you will view a video featuring respected counselors, teachers, and healthcare professionals on divorce and recovery topics.
